fusions.name: Reversed Head
fusions.desc: Strikes with the spike on the back of the axe head, dealing 14 damage, stunning the target for 1 second and leaving it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Thin End First
fusions.desc: Drives a wedge through a 4-tile cone ahead of you, dealing 28 damage to everything in it, plus 5% of the target's maximum health if it is a boss or elite.

fusions.name: Ground to a Point
fusions.desc: Increases your piercing damage by 25% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Notch by Notch
fusions.desc: Every hit you land scores a notch on that enemy, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: a blow strikes that enemy for 34% of your weapon damage per stack (170% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
